endorsements.label: Hacking Sony PlayStation Blu-ray Drives
endorsements.description: Xbox 360 video game console had a number of widely known hacks for firmware of its optical disc drives. However, it was never the case with Blu-ray disc drives of Sony PlayStation video game consoles. In fact, up until recently there was no much information available on this subject publicly. In this presentation, I would like to share my journey of delving deep into internals and security of Sony PlayStation Blu-ray disc drives. Read more
